This section publishes the validated component evidence this project already holds as structured data. Every value below is projected from that data — nothing here is re-typed, summarised into a grade, or reconciled by hand.

## How to read these pages

- **Per-domain, never per-part.** Coverage is stated one domain at a time. There is no component-wide pass/fail verdict, and the absence of an open domain is not a safety claim.
- **Verdicts keep their exact wording.** A distributor-confirmed identity and a primary-source confirmation are different verdicts and are shown as different verdicts.
- **Open means unresolved, not unsafe.** An open domain names the reason it is open and the exact facts that block it.
- **Sources may be unavailable.** A source recorded as unavailable stays visible so the gap is auditable rather than invisible.
